result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure: its white headline and subtitle text sit on a light mint-green background, making them nearly illegible. A secondary contrast issue affects the favorite (heart) icon on the second restaurant card.

issues.description: In the green promo banner, the headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtitle 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white on a very light mint background, resulting in extremely low contrast and text that is effectively unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark green/near-black tone (or darken the banner background) so contrast meets at least 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) uses a dark circular background with a dark outline, so it nearly disappears against the dark image area, unlike the white heart button on the ramen card above it.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite-button treatment across all cards (e.g. white/translucent circle with a dark heart outline) so it is always visible over imagery.

issues.description: Inconsistent visual weight in the promo banner: the 'Order now' button is high-contrast while the surrounding copy is not, making the banner look half-rendered or broken.
issues.suggestion: Align the banner's typography and button styling into a single accessible color scheme so the block reads as one coherent component.
